COMPARISON

21Life, Playgroup
or Lifetap?

Three options for Commander. Here is what they offer and why you might choose an open source project.

21Life is free and publishes its code under the MIT license. Its life counter, history, statistics, groups, seasons and awards are included. Playgroup and Lifetap also offer free tools: access to the code is one reason to consider 21Life.

Comparison by the 21Life project · Sources reviewed on 19 October 2026.

Features, cost and license
Aspect21LifePlaygroup.ggLifetap

MIT LICENSE

Free to use.
Free to modify.

An app can be free without publishing its code. 21Life offers both: use the features without a subscription, and read, modify and redistribute the software under the MIT license.

YOUR GROUP’S CHOICE

Choose what
your group needs.

Playgroup documents ELO statistics and a separate virtual tabletop. Lifetap offers local use without an account and several tabletop modes. Those needs differ from access to source code: choose based on how you play.

Open source and privacy

Open code can be inspected. It does not mean no data is processed: accounts and shared games require storage and sync. Imports, images and website analytics also involve services and privacy policies.
